summary: Iteration 24 frontend testing: music toggle relocation from Header to global floating button. All 7 requested checks passed. Header music button removed on every route. Floating button (data-testid='floating-music-btn') present on /, /komutanlar, /login, /puanlar, /uyeler, /etkinlikler. Computed style exactly matches spec (fixed, bottom=80px, right=16px, 48x48, borderRadius=50%, gradient #C0392B->#E74C1A, boxShadow rgba(231,76,26,0.5) 0px 4px 12px 0px, zIndex=9000). Audio URL HEAD returns 200 audio/mpeg (6.3MB). Toggle works: default aria-pressed=false, animation=none, VolumeX icon; after click aria-pressed=true, animationName=musicPulse; second click reverts to paused. Dropdown export/logout intact. Zero console errors.

issues: Floating music button renders on /login page because Layout wraps login route. Not blocking; recorded per request. If undesired on login, exclude via route check.

critical_code_review_comments: MusicButton correctly cleans up audio on unmount (pause + src cleared).
Consider conditional rendering to skip MusicButton on /login if product wants it hidden pre-auth.
